summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Season Management module. Backend 100% (12/12 tests). Frontend 100% working - all CRUD operations, season detail with matches/training tabs, team performance chart all functional.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/seasons returns list with stats (matches, training_sessions, wins, draws, losses)
Backend: 3 seeded seasons present (Summer Camp 2026, 2025-2026 Season, 2024-2025 Season)
Backend: Active season (2025-2026) has correct stats - 6 matches, 10 training, 2W-1D-0L
Backend: POST /api/seasons creates new season correctly
Backend: GET /api/seasons/{id} returns detail with matches, training_sessions, teams, stats
Backend: Season detail includes goals_for and goals_against
Backend: Match structure in detail has all required fields (date, team_id, opponent, type, status)
Backend: Training structure in detail has all required fields (date, title, type, location, time)
Backend: GET non-existent season returns 404
Backend: PUT /api/seasons/{id} updates season fields correctly
Backend: PUT /api/seasons/{id} with status=active deactivates other active seasons
Backend: DELETE /api/seasons/{id} deletes season and returns 404 on subsequent GET
Frontend: Login and navigate to /seasons via sidebar Trophy icon
Frontend: Seasons page shows 3 seeded seasons with cards
Frontend: Each season card shows status badge (Active/Upcoming/Completed)
Frontend: Each season card shows date range and description
Frontend: Season cards show stats: matches played, training sessions, W-D-L record
Frontend: Active season shows 'Active' badge with NO 'Set Active' button
Frontend: Non-active seasons show 'Set Active' button
Frontend: 'Add Season' button opens create form
Frontend: Create form has name, status dropdown, start/end date pickers, description fields
Frontend: Creating new season adds it to list (tested with TEST_Playwright Season)
Frontend: Delete button removes season from list
Frontend: Clicking season name navigates to /seasons/{id} detail page
Frontend: Season detail header shows name, dates, status badge, description
Frontend: Season detail stats grid: Total Matches (6), Wins (2), Draws (1), Losses (0), Training (10)
Frontend: Season detail shows Goals For (10) and Goals Against (4)
Frontend: Season detail has Overview/Matches/Training tabs
Frontend: Overview tab shows Team Performance bar chart with teams (U10 Lions, U12 Tigers, U14 Eagles)
Frontend: Matches tab shows table with Date, Team, Opponent, Type, Result, Status columns
Frontend: Matches show correct results (5-2, 0-0) and status (Completed/Upcoming)
Frontend: Training tab shows table with Date, Session Title, Type, Location, Time columns
Frontend: Training shows various types (physical, technical, tactical, regular)
Frontend: Back to Seasons link navigates back to seasons list
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Season stats aggregation correctly filters by date range
Active season toggle correctly deactivates other seasons (sets to 'completed')
seed_data_creation: Backend has 3 seeded seasons. Active season (2025-2026) has 6 matches and 10 training sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Season Management module fully functional. All CRUD operations tested and working. Season detail aggregates matches/training by comparing date field against season start_date/end_date. Team performance chart shows wins/draws/losses per team from completed matches. Console error 'Failed to fetch' on initial page load is cosmetic - happens before auth token is available.

backend_seasons_api.GET_list: Returns seasons with embedded stats (matches, training_sessions, wins, draws, losses, completed_matches)
backend_seasons_api.POST_create: Creates season with name, start_date, end_date, description, status
backend_seasons_api.GET_detail: Returns season with matches[], training_sessions[], teams[], stats{total_matches, completed_matches, total_training, wins, draws, losses, goals_for, goals_against}
backend_seasons_api.PUT_update: Updates name, dates, status. Setting status=active deactivates other active seasons
backend_seasons_api.DELETE: Deletes season, returns 404 on subsequent access

frontend_seasons_page.list_view: Cards with status badge, dates, description, stats (matches, training, W-D-L), View Details link
frontend_seasons_page.create_form: Name, status dropdown, date pickers, description textarea
frontend_seasons_page.actions: Set Active button (non-active only), Delete button per season

frontend_season_detail.stats_grid: Total Matches, Wins, Draws, Losses, Training Sessions, Goals For, Goals Against
